title: New Delhi House Microbiome
description: This study aims to investigate the complex and diverse microbial community inside the urban dwellings of New Delhi, India through whole metagenome shotgun sequencing of samples from different locations and surface types within the houses and identify the potentially pathogenic species and antimicrobial resistance gene profiling of the microbiome of the houses to evaluate potential health risks inside the urban houses.
center: CSIR-Institute of Genomics and Integrative Biology
